title: CRM Pipeline
description: Lead volume, pipeline value and quotation progress at a glance — open KPIs, lead trend and mix by status/source, opportunity value by sales stage, a lead-to-quotation funnel and an open-opportunities list.
notes: Built from Leads (enabled only), Opportunities and submitted Quotations. Pipeline amounts use each Opportunity's base currency via Company.default_currency, so a reading that spans companies with different currencies prints bare. Lead source uses utm_source (blank shown as Unknown). Open Leads exclude status Converted; open Opportunities/Quotations use status Open. Readers need Lead, Opportunity, Quotation and Company tables.
